title: A tiny performance improvement
description:
Just wanted to send that since I had that hanging locally.

a8cc63d96f26cfcb90e336a7bfd930a5a7fccd48 is a nice improvement, since we are able to use the vectorization speed of `grepl()` instead of calling `is_tz_present()` multiple times.

Also added comments to mention that the repeated operation is a WIP (I don't want to put the effort to solve it now since I don't really use this type of date formatting, but wanted to leave a comment in case the code base becomes cryptic over time)

title: Improve performance
description:
# Summary

I noticed that many operations were performed more than once unnecessarily.

This PR aims to reduce this duplication.

It is not a perfect solution but it is the one that respects more the current structure.

I notice a speedup 690 ms -> 580 ms

# Related GitHub Issues and PRs

- Ref: #15,
- Ref: https://github.com/rstudio/gt/issues/1531

title: Improve performance somewhat
description:
# Summary

Not much, but still minor improvement


* 99abec0f82fefc6611d5dd56a255018e209a5e89 vectorizing grepl search for timezone 330 ms -> 90 ms


## Profiling

```r
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
b <- pizzaplace |> 
  mutate(
    date_time = paste(date, time),
    date_time = ymd_hms(date_time),
    .keep = "unused"
  ) |> 
  slice_sample(
    n = 150
  )
profvis::profvis({b |> 
  gt() |> 
  fmt_datetime(date_time) |> 
    gt:::render_as_html()
})
```

description: This ensures that the `W` field pattern emits the correct week-in-month numerical value for any supported locale. This adds CLDR datasets that pertain to locale parsing/normalization and `weekStart` DoW values for all territories.
